title: A new predictive equation for resting energy expenditure in healthy individuals (Mifflin, St Jeor et al. 1990)
content: Mifflin MD, St Jeor ST, et al., American Journal of Clinical Nutrition 1990 — Derived a new predictive equation for resting metabolic rate from a sample of healthy adults, using weight, height, age, and sex: RMR = 10×weight(kg) + 6.25×height(cm) − 5×age(y) + 5 for men, or −161 for women. This equation was shown to be more accurate on average for the contemporary (at publication) adult population than the older Harris-Benedict equation, and is the formula this codebase's nutrition_calculator.ts implements as its baseline.

title: A new predictive equation for resting energy expenditure in healthy individuals (Mifflin, St Jeor et al. 1990)
content: Mifflin-St Jeor 1990 — Important scope limits (product-relevant): the original validation sample was healthy, non-pregnant, non-elite-athlete adults. It is not validated for children, pregnant/lactating people, or individuals with significantly atypical body composition (e.g. very high muscle mass or clinical conditions affecting metabolism) — for those groups it should be used cautiously if at all, and flagged as a rough estimate rather than a precise prescription.
